root_cause.text: The `iwlwifi` driver fails to cancel the deferred `mlo_scan_start_wk` work during station disconnection (state-down transition), allowing the work to execute after the associated virtual interface (`vif`) is freed or changed.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the cancellation of `mlo_scan_start_wk` from `iwl_mld_cleanup_vif` and adds `wiphy_delayed_work_cancel(mld->wiphy, &mld_vif->mlo_scan_start_wk)` to `iwl_mld_move_sta_state_down`, which is executed during disconnection.

intent_record.how: This change stops the explicit cancellation of the mlo_scan_start_wk delayed work during the virtual interface cleanup process, relying on other cleanup mechanisms or preventing redundant cancellation.

intent_record.intent_summary: Cancel the pending MLO scan start delayed work when moving the station state down to prevent execution in an invalid state.
intent_record.what: Added a call to wiphy_delayed_work_cancel to cancel the mld_vif->mlo_scan_start_wk delayed work.
intent_record.how: Ensures that the scheduled MLO scan start work is cancelled when the station state is moved down, preventing it from running in an invalid state.
